compiled_state.title: As a plugin maintainer, both merge modes emit a compatible CONFLICT_DATA schema for resolve-conflicts
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Verify that both merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh emit a compatible CONFLICT_DATA schema; update resolve-conflicts SKILL.md to handle whichever conflict-signal shape is chosen.
**Why**: resolve-conflicts SKILL.md must handle conflicts from both merge modes without branching on merge strategy; a schema mismatch would silently break conflict resolution for PR-mode users.
**Scope**:
- IN: CONFLICT_DATA schema audit between both merge scripts; resolve-conflicts SKILL.md update for chosen schema; regression test verifying schema compatibility
- OUT: merge-to-main-pr.sh implementation (S3a); direct mode extraction (S1)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh both emit CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema on merge conflict, OR merge-to-main-pr.sh documents that conflicts are surfaced via a different signal and resolve-conflicts SKILL.md is updated to handle whichever shape is chosen
  <- Satisfies: "merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh both emit CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema on conflict, OR merge-to-main-pr.sh documents that conflicts are surfaced via a different signal — plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md is updated to handle whichever shape is chosen"
- When this story is complete, a regression test verifies CONFLICT_DATA schema compatibility between both modes
  <- Satisfies: "verified by a regression test"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] resolve-conflicts SKILL.md must be updated to reflect the chosen conflict-signal shape regardless of which option is taken

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
